extDescription.message: Block ads everywhere, YouTube video ads, banners, pop-ups, trackers, cookie prompts and anti-adblock walls. Free, fast and private.

cosmeticsTitle.message: Cosmetic filtering on this site (turn off if the layout breaks)

logUnavailable.message: Log unavailable right now (browser quota) — try again in a minute.

opt_keep_settings_allowlist_and_filters_.message: Keep settings, allowlist and filters in sync on every Chrome you're signed into

opt_remove_video_ads_on_youtube_turn_off.message: Remove video ads on YouTube. Turn off if videos won't play.

opt_hide_disable_your_adblocker_walls_an.message: Hide "disable your adblocker" walls and restore the page

opt_strip_utm_fbclid_gclid_and_other_cli.message: Strip utm_*, fbclid, gclid and other click identifiers from the links you open

opt_block_known_malware_domains_urlhaus_.message: Block known malware domains (URLhaus list by abuse.ch)

opt_disable_google_topics_floc_and_prote.message: Disable Google Topics, FLoC and Protected Audience ad APIs on every site

opt_stop_third_party_hyperlink_auditing_.message: Stop third-party hyperlink-auditing / beacon pings, strip tracking cookies from known ad-tech responses, and block browser cryptomining scripts. Turn off if a site's analytics-dependent feature misbehaves.

opt_fetches_new_block_rules_and_youtube_.message: Fetches new block rules and YouTube fixes from adblock.carbonstealth.eu about twice a day. Data only, no code; the request carries no identifiers or browsing data.

opt_live_log_of_ads_caught_heuristically.message: Live log of ads caught heuristically (no filter list), newest first.

opt_subscribed_lists_are_fetched_as_text.message: Subscribed lists are fetched as text (never code), kept up to date daily, and live in the managed blocks above. Remove a list to drop its rules.

opt_elements_you_hid_manually_with_the_p.message: Elements you hid manually with the picker, grouped by site.

opt_live_diagnostics_everything_is_compu.message: Live diagnostics — everything is computed locally. If something is red, "Update now" or reloading the extension usually fixes it.

opt_supreme_adblock_is_free_for_everyone.message: Supreme AdBlock is free for everyone. If you'd like to help keep it maintained, donations are welcome, never required.

opt_subscribe_to_a_filter_list_url_e_g_h.message: Subscribe to a filter list URL (e.g. https://…/list.txt)

opt_smart_desc.message: Catches ads no filter list knows yet: cross-origin frames sized like standard ad slots are hidden on sight, no rules needed.

opt_allow_desc.message: Ads are not blocked on these domains.

opt_fh_site.message: hides it only on that site.

opt_no_sw.message: No response from the service worker.

opt_filter_status.message: Filter set v$1, updated $2. Data only, nothing about you is sent.

opt_lists_intro.message: EasyList and EasyPrivacy are always on. The lists below are open-licence lists compiled into the extension, so turning one on downloads nothing, except a list marked as coming from its author.

opt_lists_regional_desc.message: The list for your browser's language turns on by itself. Add others if you often read sites in other languages.

opt_focus_desc.message: Hide what is not an ad but still gets in the way. Everything here is off until you turn it on.

opt_list_ubo_desc.message: Ads, trackers, anti-adblock fixes and site repairs from the uBlock Origin team.

opt_list_plowe_desc.message: A long-running list of ad and tracking servers.

opt_focus_social_desc.message: Share buttons, like boxes and embedded feeds.

opt_focus_chat_desc.message: The floating chat bubbles in the corner of the page.

opt_focus_newsletters_desc.message: “Subscribe to our newsletter” boxes and overlays.

opt_focus_notifications_desc.message: “Allow notifications?” boxes that sites show before the browser asks.

opt_focus_ai_desc.message: Chatbot bubbles and AI suggestion panels added to pages.

opt_focus_other_desc.message: Sticky bars, “open in app” banners and similar clutter.

opt_remote_hint.message: Not bundled (no licence to redistribute it): your browser downloads it from $1 when you turn it on.

opt_lists_error.message: Chrome refused this combination of lists ($1). Turn some off.

reportBroken.message: Site broken? Fix it or tell us

rep_fix_desc.message: Most problems go away with one of these. Each one applies to this site only; the tab reloads.

rep_tell_desc.message: We fix broken sites for everyone through the signed filter update, usually within a day. Nothing is sent by the extension: the report opens in your own email app, and you see every word of it first.

rep_what_ph.message: e.g. the video does not start, a white box covers the article…

rep_full_url.message: Include the full page address (only the site name otherwise)

rep_done_cosm.message: Element hiding is off on this site. Reloaded — is it fixed?

rep_done_allow.message: Ads are allowed on this site. Reloaded — is it fixed?

rep_done_pause.message: Paused for 30 minutes. If the site works now, please tell us below.

opt_focus_shorts_desc.message: The Shorts shelves, tab and suggestions on YouTube.

opt_focus_onetap_desc.message: The account picker that appears in the corner of many sites. The sign-in buttons keep working.
